candidates.change_summary: Change the recipient of the transfer from the provided _recipient to the contract owner (owner) so funds always go to owner instead of caller-supplied address.
Send zero value by transferring 0 wei instead of the contract's full balance, leaving funds in the contract.
Require that the caller is NOT the owner (negate the require), so only non-owners can invoke withdrawAll successfully.
Remove the require guard so anyone can call withdrawAll and drain the contract to the provided recipient.
Swap transfer to owner and then to recipient by first transferring full balance to owner, making recipient receive nothing (order change causing different end-state).
After successful require, set owner to the recipient before transferring, so funds go to the (now) owner (the provided _recipient).
